name: error_id
description: Unique id for this error row (uuid hex)

name: component
description: What raised it, e.g. fn-retail-store-matching, fn-store-geocoder

name: test_type
description: 'function' (data check inside a function) or 'infrastructure' (run/deploy/scheduler health)

name: check_name
description: Short slug of the failed check, e.g. zero_stores_matched

name: context
description: Optional JSON-encoded structured detail (counts, ids, etc.)

name: run_id
description: Correlates rows from the same function run
